registration.verified_by: overlay reviewed 2026-09-06; eye sockets, third eye and toothed jaw single-imaged at 8x zoom
registration.note: Automatic silhouette registration found no viable fit. At head height the plate silhouette is dominated by the wide gold horn plates, which the reconstruction placed differently, so equal normalized u stops meaning the same feature and face texels sampled hood. Registered instead by aligning the bright bone mask centroid directly, then swept scale 0.126-0.146 and judged on eye-socket doubling; 0.134-0.138 single-image, outside that they double.

geometry.provenance: Tencent Hunyuan3D-2mv (fp16, 50 steps, octree 512, seed 12345) from view-01/view-03. Draft: 552,520 faces, 104.6s. Octree raised from 380 to sharpen the recessed mask inside the hood.

regions.note: shoulder detector 0.7735, verified visually at the collar below the hooded mask

uv_density.note: Tuned for this silhouette: the crested helm plus halo ring is a far larger share of the body than a normal head, so it needs much LESS boost than Vrol (5.5) or Yandir (8.0). head_scale 5.5 overshot to 321^2 with the head taking 38.5% of the atlas; 2.0 lands ~258^2 at ~25%.
